description: Browser responsive layouts (360px mobile, 768px tablet, 1440px desktop), accessibility, Bengali typography and reduced-motion

verification_details.mobile_360px: Vertical stacked layout (.layout-container { flex-direction: column !important; }), horizontal wrapping navigation, full-width main content area.
verification_details.tablet_768px_and_desktop: Flexible responsive grid and flexbox containers adapting to 768px and 1440px viewports without horizontal overflow.
verification_details.touch_targets: Minimum 44px touch targets on buttons, inputs, and tabs with touch-action: manipulation to prevent double-tap zoom delays.
verification_details.accessibility_focus: Explicit focus-visible outline indicators (2px solid #2563eb, offset 2px) for keyboard navigability.
verification_details.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule disabling animations and smooth transitions for sensitive users.
verification_details.bengali_rendering: Font stack prioritizing system Bengali fonts (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Kalpurush, SolaimanLipi, sans-serif).
